verdict.rationale: Docs show an OpenAI-compatible REST API and a gRPC API, plus quickstart code samples in Python/JavaScript/curl, implying developers can build against xAI's official interfaces and reuse OpenAI SDKs, but the evidence never names or documents a dedicated, xAI-published SDK library (e.g., a maintained Python/JS package with versioned releases). Missing for 10: an explicit official SDK repo/package listing, language coverage beyond curl/Python/JS snippets, and independent developer confirmation of SDK reliability.
